capabilities: open a searchable menu of 52 Markdown insertion entries
format selected text with headings, lists, callouts, and links
configure table columns, rows, and alignment before inserting
insert note, heading, and block links and embeds by searching the vault
insert vault attachments such as images, PDFs, and Canvas files
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it is desktop-only (Obsidian 1.8.7+), and the detailed usage and manual installation guide is hosted outside the README.
problem: Remembering Markdown syntax and typing note links, tables, and embeds by hand is slow, and Obsidian's built-in insertion commands cover only part of this.
summary: Searchable menu that inserts Markdown templates, formats selected text, and inserts note links and vault attachments without needing to know the syntax.
